title.en: Five tones of one ink

desc.zh: 焦、浓、重、淡、清,同一锭墨兑不同的水。层级靠浓淡:最要紧的一笔用焦墨,远处和背景用淡墨、清墨。写字只用焦、浓两档。
desc.en: Burnt, thick, heavy, light, clear: one ink, different amounts of water. Hierarchy comes from depth — the key stroke in burnt ink, far things in light and clear. Words only in the two darkest.

title.zh: 三种笔:提按 · 飞白 · 晕染
title.en: Three brush effects: pressure, dry brush, bleed

desc.zh: 提按:起笔斜切按下,行笔略提,收笔出锋。飞白:墨少了笔毛分开,白丝出在笔画里面,边上的毛先断。晕染:一笔落定后墨往纸里渗开。
desc.en: Pressure: a slanted press, a lighter run, a pointed exit. Dry brush: as ink runs out the hairs part and white streaks open inside the stroke, edge hairs first. Bleed: once a stroke lands, ink creeps into the paper.

title.zh: 印章:朱文 · 白文 · 盖印
title.en: Seals: red text, white text, stamping

desc.zh: 一方朱印是画面的句号。朱文是红字,白文是红底留出纸色的字;边缘蚀出残缺才像石头刻的。盖印:印落下、颜色压实。
desc.en: A red seal is the full stop of a picture. Red-text seals carve the characters; white-text seals carve the ground. A chipped edge reads as stone. Stamping: the seal lands and the colour presses in.

title.en: One mountain, four ways of colouring

desc.zh: 水墨不一定是黑白的。纯水墨只有墨和印;浅绛加淡赭石、淡花青;青绿用石青石绿,颜色重;没骨不勾墨线,颜色直接泼染。
desc.en: Ink wash need not be black and white. Pure ink: ink and a seal. Light-ochre: pale ochre and indigo. Blue-green: heavy azurite and malachite. Boneless: no ink outline, colour laid straight on.

title.en: Plum, orchid, bamboo, chrysanthemum, pine

desc.zh: 四君子加一棵松,每样都是 props.js 里一个函数:竹竿分节、节处一笔,竹叶一笔一片;兰叶细粗细交叉一次;梅花五点胭脂;菊瓣短笔围一圈;松针扇形排开。
desc.en: The four gentlemen plus a pine, each one function in props.js: bamboo in segments with a stroke at each node and one stroke per leaf; orchid leaves thin–thick–thin crossing once; plum blossoms five rouge dots; chrysanthemum petals short strokes in rings; pine needles fanned out.

title.zh: 山石 · 水 · 云 · 舟 · 亭 · 桥
title.en: Rock, water, cloud, boat, pavilion, bridge

desc.zh: 山水画里反复出现的几样:山先铺淡墨再勾脊、加几笔皴;石头侧锋勾轮廓、点苔;水只画几道断开的细纹;云一笔回旋;舟、亭、桥都只要四五笔。
desc.en: The pieces a landscape keeps using: a hill is a pale wash, then a ridge and a few texture strokes; a rock is side-tip outline plus moss dots; water is a few broken lines; a cloud one curling stroke; a boat, a pavilion, a bridge four or five strokes each.

title.zh: 人物剪影 · 鹤 · 鱼 · 马
title.en: Figures, crane, fish, horse

desc.zh: 人物只画剪影:斗笠、披风一笔湿墨、剑一道干笔;书生长衫两笔;太极一个起势。鹤身留白只勾淡墨,丹顶一点朱砂;鱼一笔兰叶;马身侧锋一大笔。
desc.en: People as silhouettes: a hat, a cloak in one wet stroke, a sword as one dry line; a scholar in two strokes; a taiji opening pose. The crane is pale with a dot of cinnabar on its crown; a fish is one orchid-leaf stroke; a horse one broad side-tip stroke.

title.en: Layers: far is pale, near is dark

desc.zh: 底层基础设施画成淡墨远山,越往上墨越浓;正在讲的那一层用焦墨粗笔,加一方朱印。层次靠墨色深浅,不靠颜色。(远山是比喻)
desc.en: Infrastructure at the bottom is a pale far ridge; each layer up is darker; the layer being explained gets burnt ink, a heavy brush and a red seal. Depth carries the hierarchy, not colour. (The far ridge is a metaphor.)

title.en: Data flow: water in a channel

desc.zh: 请求像水,沿渠走;分叉处是判断,命中缓存走上渠,没命中走下渠查库,两路在出口汇合。花青只代表「数据」一件事。(水渠是比喻)
desc.en: A request flows like water along a channel; the fork is a decision — a cache hit takes the upper channel, a miss the lower one to the database; both meet at the outlet. Indigo means one thing only: data. (The channel is a metaphor.)

title.en: A flow with a decision: sign-in

desc.zh: 判断用藤黄淡彩的菱形,是 / 否两条出口都写字;错三次锁定,用胭脂只标这一处。每个框四笔画成,线不出飞白,免得箭头断开。
desc.en: The decision is a gamboge-washed diamond with both exits labelled; three failures lock the account, and rouge marks only that. Each box is four brush strokes; lines carry no dry brush so arrows never break.

title.en: A loop: one turn of an event loop

desc.zh: 一笔圆相画出循环,四站按顺序点亮:取任务、执行、处理微任务、渲染;一滴墨沿着圆走,6 秒一圈,一直转。
desc.en: One brush circle (enso) is the loop; four stations light up in order — take a task, run it, drain microtasks, render — and an ink drop rides the circle, 6 s a turn, forever.

title.zh: 哈希表:墨点落进对应的抽屉
title.en: A hash table: each drop falls into its drawer

desc.zh: 五个字按「码点 mod 7」算出抽屉号,墨点落进去;「竹」和别的字算到同一个抽屉,挂在后面(链表)。左边高亮到哪一行,右边就落到哪一滴。
desc.en: Five characters, drawer = code point mod 7; each drop falls in. 竹 lands in a drawer already taken and hangs behind it (a chain). The lit line on the left and the falling drop on the right move together.

title.en: Recursion: hills inside hills

desc.zh: fact(4) 调 fact(3),一层套一层,每进一层画一座更小、更浓的山;到 fact(1) 见底,再一层层带着结果回来:1、2、6,最后 24。
desc.en: fact(4) calls fact(3), and so on: each call is a smaller, darker hill inside the last; at fact(1) it bottoms out and the results climb back: 1, 2, 6, and finally 24.

title.zh: 刘徽割圆术:边数翻倍逼近 π
title.en: Liu Hui: doubling the sides to close in on π

desc.zh: 圆里先画正六边形,半周长是 3;每次把边数翻一倍:12 边 3.1058,24 边 3.1326,……,192 边 3.14145。数由同一段代码算出(边长 s₂ₙ = √(2 − √(4 − sₙ²)))。
desc.en: Start with a hexagon inside the circle: half its perimeter is 3. Double the sides each time: 12 sides 3.1058, 24 sides 3.1326 … 192 sides 3.14145, computed by the same code.

title.en: Zhao Shuang's figure: the Pythagorean theorem

desc.zh: 勾 3、股 4。四个直角三角形围成边长为弦的大正方形,中间空出边长 1 的小正方形:弦² = 4 × 6 + 1 = 25,弦 = 5。
desc.en: Legs 3 and 4. Four right triangles make a big square on the hypotenuse with a small 1×1 hole: c² = 4 × 6 + 1 = 25, so c = 5.

title.zh: 梯度下降:墨滴滚进山谷
title.en: Gradient descent: an ink drop rolls into the valley

desc.zh: 从 x = -2.6 出发,每步往坡度的反方向走 0.45 倍坡度;第 17 步坡度小于 0.02,停在 x = 1.70,f = 0.886。曲线和每一步都由同一个函数算出。
desc.en: Start at x = -2.6; each step moves 0.45 × the slope downhill. After 17 steps the slope is under 0.02: x = 1.70, f = 0.886. The curve and every step come from the same function.

title.zh: 冒泡排序:竹节长短换位
title.en: Bubble sort: bamboo stalks trade places

desc.zh: 六根竹子的节数 5、2、8、1、6、3。相邻两根比一比,左边高就换;一共换了 8 次,排成 1、2、3、5、6、8。每一帧都是真跑排序记下的状态。
desc.en: Six stalks of 5, 2, 8, 1, 6, 3 joints. Compare neighbours, swap if the left one is taller: 8 swaps in all, ending 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 8. Every frame is a state recorded from a real run.

title.en: A documentation page

desc.zh: 毛笔字只用在页标题;正文、代码、侧栏照常是宋体和等宽字;一道墨痕当分隔线,一方印章当「稳定版」标记。宣纸纹理很淡,正文对比度不受影响。
desc.en: Brush lettering only for the page title; body, code and sidebar stay in serif and monospace; one ink stroke as a divider, one seal as the "stable" badge. The paper grain is faint enough not to cost body contrast.

title.zh: 界面组件:按钮墨晕 · 开关 · 输入框 · 空状态
title.en: UI pieces: an ink-bleed button, a switch, an input, an empty state

desc.zh: 按钮按下时墨从中间晕开;开关拨到「开」是一滴浓墨,「关」是一圈淡墨;输入框只有一道毛笔下划线;空状态画一只空船,不写「暂无数据」那种冷冰冰的字。
desc.en: A pressed button lets ink bleed from its centre; a switch is a drop of thick ink when on and a pale ring when off; an input is one brushed underline; an empty state is an empty boat instead of a cold "no data".

title.en: One phone screen

desc.zh: 顶上一抹远山当页头,标题毛笔字;列表照常是清楚的楷体和宋体,完成的那项盖一方小印;底栏四个图标都是一两笔画出来的。
desc.en: A strip of far hills as the header with a brush title; the list stays plain kai and serif, a done item gets a small seal; the four tab icons are one or two strokes each.

title.en: A website first screen

desc.zh: 一句话大标题用毛笔写出,一个按钮,右边一幅会动的小山水;导航和正文照常是清楚的宋体。首屏只讲一件事。
desc.en: One sentence in brush letters, one button, a small moving landscape on the right; navigation and body stay in plain serif. The first screen says one thing.

title.zh: 墨条柱状图 + 山脊线折线
title.en: Ink bars and a ridge line

desc.zh: 一年十二个月的雨量(示例数据):墨条越长墨越浓,最多的 六月 236 毫米用焦墨并盖印;全年合计 1412 毫米。气温画成一道山脊线,线下淡墨像远山。
desc.en: Twelve months of rainfall (sample data): longer bars, darker ink; the wettest month, 6, at 236 mm is burnt ink with a seal; 1412 mm in the year. Temperature is a ridge line with a pale wash beneath, like a far hill.

title.en: "River Snow"

desc.zh: 柳宗元《江雪》。山只勾阴面,其余空着当雪;一叶孤舟一个蓑笠翁,水不画;诗竖排题在右边的留白里,一列一列写出;雪一直慢慢落。
desc.en: Liu Zongyuan, "River Snow" (9th c.). Hills are inked only on their shaded sides, the rest left as snow; one boat, one fisherman, the water unpainted; the poem is written column by column into the empty right side; snow keeps falling, slowly.

title.zh: 《枫桥夜泊》:磁青纸上的泥金夜景
title.en: "Night Mooring by Maple Bridge" in gold on indigo

desc.zh: 张继《枫桥夜泊》。这张固定用磁青纸配泥金,不随页面主题变:夜景本来就是暗的。渔火一点藤黄,枫叶几点朱膘,寒山寺的钟声一圈圈荡开。
desc.en: Zhang Ji, "Night Mooring by Maple Bridge" (8th c.). Fixed on indigo paper in gold whatever the page theme — a night scene is dark anyway. One gamboge fishing light, a few vermilion maple leaves, and the temple bell rings out in widening circles.

title.en: "Prelude to Water Melody": the moon left unpainted

desc.zh: 苏轼《水调歌头》开头两句。月亮一笔不画,画的是它周围的淡墨云(烘云托月);云每 14 秒来回移一次;诗只题两句,留白比字多。
desc.en: The opening of Su Shi's "Prelude to Water Melody". The moon is never painted — only the pale cloud around it (烘云托月); the clouds drift back and forth every 14 s; just two lines of the poem, more empty paper than words.

title.en: Spring: peach petals falling

desc.zh: 没骨画法:桃花不勾线,胭脂直接点染;柳条几笔嫩绿;两只燕子;花瓣一直慢慢飘。
desc.en: Boneless style: the peach blossoms have no ink outline, rouge laid straight on; a few young-green willow strands; two swallows; petals keep drifting down.

title.en: Summer: lotus in the rain

desc.zh: 浓墨重绿:荷叶是大片泼墨加石绿,荷花几瓣胭脂;雨用细线斜着下,比 graphite 的雨慢。
desc.en: Heavy ink and deep green: lotus leaves are splashed ink over malachite, the flower a few rouge petals; rain falls in fine slanting lines, slower than graphite rain.

title.en: Autumn: maples and geese

desc.zh: 浅绛:山是淡赭石,枫叶点朱膘;一行雁排成人字,慢慢飞过空着的天。
desc.en: Light ochre: pale ochre hills, maple leaves dotted in vermilion; a line of geese in a V crossing the empty sky, slowly.

title.en: Winter: snow and plum

desc.zh: 冬天留白当雪:山只画阴面,树枝上面空着一道就是积雪;一枝红梅是全图唯一的颜色;雪一直落。
desc.en: In winter the paper is the snow: hills inked only on their shaded side, a bare strip along each branch is the snow on it; one red plum branch is the only colour; snow keeps falling.

title.en: A level-distance handscroll: the camera pans

desc.zh: 横卷是边走边看的:整幅比画框宽一半,画完后镜头 16 秒一个来回慢慢横移;远山淡、近岸浓,中间一大片水不画。
desc.en: A handscroll is read while moving: the painting is half again as wide as the frame, and once painted the camera pans across and back every 16 s; far hills pale, near banks dark, a wide river left unpainted.

title.en: A high-distance hanging scroll: a waterfall

desc.zh: 竖轴从山脚仰望山顶:主峰压满上半幅,一道瀑布从两崖之间落下,白练不画,只画两边的崖;水一直往下流;山脚一个小小的书生。
desc.en: A hanging scroll looks up from the foot: the main peak fills the top half, a waterfall drops between two cliffs — the water is the unpainted gap, only the cliffs are inked — and keeps flowing; a tiny scholar at the foot.

title.en: Blue-green landscape

desc.zh: 青绿设色:山先勾墨线,再上石青、石绿,颜色重;山腰几道泥金雾;亭子和桥点在中景。这是设色最重的一种,适合发布会和壁纸。
desc.en: Blue-green colouring: ink outlines first, then heavy azurite and malachite; a few gold mist bands across the slopes; a pavilion and a bridge in the middle distance. The heaviest colouring of the four — for launches and wallpapers.

title.zh: 竹林对决:刀光一道飞白
title.en: A duel in the bamboo: one flash of dry brush

desc.zh: 竹林泼墨,两个剪影隔着一片空地对立;最后一刀用一笔含墨极少的长笔,整道都是飞白;竹叶被刀风切落,一直飘。
desc.en: Splashed-ink bamboo, two silhouettes facing across an empty clearing; the final cut is one long stroke with almost no ink, all dry brush; bamboo leaves cut by the blade keep drifting down.

title.en: A swordsman on a rainy night

desc.zh: 焦墨剪影站在雨里,一盏灯笼是全图唯一的暖色;城墙、塔用淡墨推远;雨一直斜着下。
desc.en: A burnt-ink silhouette standing in the rain, one lantern the only warm colour; a city wall and pagoda pushed back in pale ink; the rain keeps slanting down.

title.zh: 太极:阴阳一笔,四式连贯
title.en: Taiji: yin-yang in one stroke, four forms in a row

desc.zh: 左边阴阳鱼:一个圆相、一道 S 形、两点,三笔画完;右边一个人连着打四式:起势、单鞭、云手、收势,每式停一下,循环。
desc.en: Left: yin-yang as one circle, one S-curve and two dots — three strokes; right: one figure moves through four forms (opening, single whip, cloud hands, closing), pausing on each, looping.

title.en: A six-panel storyboard

desc.zh: 一格一个镜头,从远景推到特写:远山 → 江上孤舟 → 船头人 → 斗笠下的眼 → 惊起的鹤 → 一方印收尾。格与格之间留白就是剪辑点。
desc.en: One shot per panel, from wide to close: far hills → a lone boat → the figure at the bow → the eye under the hat → a startled crane → a seal to close. The gaps between panels are the cuts.

title.en: A widescreen push-in

desc.zh: 2.39:1 画幅,上下黑边;画面先画完,然后镜头 6 秒慢慢推近亭中人;字幕从同一个时钟出,推到底才出第二句。
desc.en: A 2.39:1 frame with black bars; the scene is painted first, then the camera pushes in on the figure in the pavilion over 6 s; subtitles run on the same clock, the second line only when the push ends.

title.en: An ink-wash anime character sheet

desc.zh: 角色设定一页:正面、侧面、背影三个剪影,都用同样几笔(斗笠、披风、剑);色卡只有焦墨、淡墨和一处朱砂腰带 —— 颜色少,换场景也认得出是她。
desc.en: A character sheet: front, side and back as silhouettes made of the same few strokes (hat, cloak, sword); the swatches are burnt ink, pale ink and one cinnabar sash — few colours, so she is recognisable in any scene.

title.en: A 9:16 short-drama cover with safe areas

desc.zh: 竖屏封面:上 12% 放平台的标题栏、下 18% 放按钮和字幕,主体都在中间;片名用志莽行书竖写;雨一直下。(安全区虚线只在这张示意图里画,真封面不画。)
desc.en: A vertical cover: the top 12% is the platform's title bar, the bottom 18% its buttons and captions, so the subject stays in the middle; the title is vertical Zhi Mang Xing; the rain keeps falling. (The safe-area guides are drawn only in this example.)

title.en: Desktop wallpaper, 16:10

desc.zh: 山水全压在右下,左上三分之二只有极淡的远山:桌面图标放在那里不会压到画。雾 12 秒来回移一次。导出动态版:scripts/export.mjs。
desc.en: The landscape sits in the lower right; the upper-left two thirds hold only the faintest far hills, so desktop icons never cover the painting. Mist drifts every 12 s. Export a moving version with scripts/export.mjs.

title.en: Phone wallpaper

desc.zh: 上面四分之一留给时间和日期,一个淡淡的月亮放在时间下面一点;一枝梅从左下伸进来;花瓣慢慢落。
desc.en: The top quarter is left for the clock and date, a pale moon just below it; a plum branch reaches in from the lower left; petals drift down slowly.

title.en: An ink-splash reveal

desc.zh: 磁青纸上一团泥金泼开,扩到半屏停住,然后一笔写出产品名。发布会一屏只讲一件事。
desc.en: On indigo paper a splash of gold spreads to half the screen and stops; then the product name is written in one go. One thing per screen.

title.zh: 一屏一个巨大的书法数字
title.en: One huge brush numeral per screen

desc.zh: 一屏只放一个数:5。下面一行小字说它是什么 —— 只定死宣纸、水墨、提按、留白、印章这 5 样,其余都按场景放开。数字由这五样的清单长度算出。
desc.en: One number per screen: 5. One small line says what it is — only 5 things are fixed (rice paper, ink & water, press & lift, empty paper, a seal), everything else follows the scene. The number is the length of that list.

title.en: An indigo-and-gold keynote slide

desc.zh: 标题一行毛笔字,三个要点各配一笔画成的小图标(笔、山、印),一道泥金线分开标题和正文;颜色只有泥金和一方朱印。
desc.en: A brush-lettered title, three points each with a one-stroke icon (brush, hill, seal), one gold line between title and body; only gold and one red seal.

title.zh: 学习过程:一圈是怎么转的
title.en: How the loop turns

desc.zh: 画一张 → 你挑一张、说一句、留下或删掉、给一张参考图 → 记一行日志 → 算出下次的参数。二选一和说一句各算 1 份,留下、删掉、参考图各 0.5 份,审查器的意见 0.3 份;越旧越轻,半衰期 90 天。
desc.en: Paint → you pick, say, keep, delete or show a picture → one line in a log → the next parameters. A pick or a sentence weighs 1, keep / delete / a reference 0.5, a reviewer 0.3; older lines fade with a 90-day half-life.

title.zh: 分场景记:技术图爱淡,静赏爱浓
title.en: Per scene: faint for diagrams, heavy for quiet pictures

desc.zh: 模拟读者 A:技术图喜欢墨色 0.25,静赏喜欢 0.8。两组交替各答 30 题,技术图学到 0.23,静赏学到 0.73;只算整体口味的话是 0.51,两头都不对。
desc.en: Simulated reader A likes ink depth 0.25 in diagrams and 0.8 in quiet pictures. 30 questions each, alternating: diagrams learn 0.23, quiet pictures 0.73; one overall taste would be 0.51, wrong for both.

title.zh: 看图识口味:从一张你喜欢的画里量
title.en: Learning from a picture you like

desc.zh: 以一张留白 72%、两种颜料(赭石、花青)、边缘柔和的画为例:换算成留白 0.72、颜料 2 种、湿度 0.69、设色「浅绛」;记一条参考,分量相当于留下一张图,口味往它挪一步(留白 0.6 → 0.624)。飞白量不准,不换算。
desc.en: A picture with 72% empty paper, two pigments (ochre, indigo), soft edges becomes empty paper 0.72, 2 pigments, wetness 0.69, colouring "qianjiang"; one reference weighs as much as keeping a figure, so taste moves one step (empty paper 0.6 → 0.624). Dry brush cannot be measured reliably and is skipped.

title.zh: 跨风格:在铅笔画里说的话,水墨也听见
title.en: Across styles: what you said about pencil reaches ink

desc.zh: 读者在 graphite 里说了两次「字太小」,又挑了十次排线疏密。到水墨这边:字号 18 → 19(共享参数,半份分量);排线是铅笔专属,水墨的 7 个其他参数一个没动。
desc.en: In graphite the reader said "labels too small" twice and picked hatch spacing ten times. In ink: label size 18 → 19 (a shared knob, half weight); hatching is pencil-only, so ink's other 7 knobs stay put.
